bio: Bernardo Cicco was baptized Michele Angelo Bernardo on 29 September 1719 at San Mango D'Aquino, Catanzaro, Calabria, Italy, the son of Giovanni Cicco and Francesca Sposata. He married Giovanna Moraca on 26 January 1738. He is John's 8th-great-grandfather.
